title: Video face detailer
description: Detail small faces in video without per-frame identity flicker: crop a stable face window, resample it with a TEMPORAL sampler, graft only its high frequencies back. Experimental - Phase 0 is a bench GO/NO-GO before any app work. BLOCKED 2026-08-14 on MPI-506: the SeedVR2 node choice is under review (numz pack vs the bundled core nodes), and every remaining B-question takes the sampler as given.
